tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha spyi'i bsnyen thabs dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i spyi bos 'dud/ /rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi po las/ /mchog dang thun mong sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bsnyen sgrub las gsum cho ga gsungs/ /de yi dang po bsnyen pa la/ /rab 'bring tha gsum rnam dbye mang / /'dir ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa yi/ /byed thabs cung zad bri bar bya/ /de la'ang rab 'bring tha gsum yod/ /phyi ma gnyis ni 'dir mi gtogs/ /rab la sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang dben zhing yid du 'ong ba bkra shis pa'i nang du phyag dar skyang nul legs par byas/ rten mchod rnam par dag pa yang bsham/ de nas bad kan dang tsha ba shas che ba'i gang zag yin na/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor rang rang gi sgrub thabs nas bshad pa bzhin du bya/ rlung dang grang ba shas che na ma byas pas 'ong ste/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus kyi rnal 'byor bya zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ma grub kyang thun mtshams su zas za ba dang / rtsa chu 'chag pa na'ang chab la sogs pa len dgos te/ grub chen nā ro ta pa'i gsung gis/ kha mi bshal bar sngags zlos spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas stan nang tshangs can la 'jig rten pa'i shar du kha phyogs par skyil krung gnyis po gang rung ngam/ tsog pur skyil krung du 'dug pa dang / thog mar rang gi blo la brtag dpyad legs po bya dgos te/ rje bla ma'i gsung gis/ gya tshom du mi 'jug gsungs pa'i don/ rang gi sems nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog gzhan gyi dbang du 'dug na/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pas blo legs par bcos nas dge ba la bskul dgos kyi/ de ltar ma byas na nyams len nyon mongs gyi dbang du 'gro bas dge ba mi 'grub pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa'i kun slong brtan pos sems dge ba la bskul nas dran shes kyis yang yang du sems nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres pa ci thub byed pa gal che ste/

nā ro ta pas/ dad pa med pa'i le lo spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ ma rgyud dang pha rgyud so so'i lugs kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyis rgyud dag par byed cing / de nas mngon par rtogs pa sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i rim pas dmigs pa gsal rung mi gsal rung / rnam rtog gzhan gyi dbang du ma song bar/ sems 'jur mig nas drangs la shar re gshar 'don gyi tshul du 'gro ba ni/ birwa pa yab sras kyi man ngag las/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gnad du che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas rang rang gi bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i skabs su sleb pa dang / rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / khyad par du yang rang nyid gtso bo de'i zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs bzhugs stangs dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la nga rgyal yun ring po'i bar du 'dzin/ las dang po pas dmigs pa gsal po med kyang lha de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po la yun ring mnyam par bzhag pa la phan yon che ste/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /'grub rgyu'i sangs rgyas ni/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas phreng ba byin rlabs dang bcas pa byas la/ rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dmigs pa la nan tan bskyed cing / sngags lhag chad med pa dag por bzla dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru 'khyal ba spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bzlas pa'i skabs thams cad du 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi dmigs pa la gcun dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ bsams pa med par sngags bzlas spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /lha'i dmigs pa yang yang du gsal gdab dgos te/

nā ro ta pas/ lha mi gsal bar sngags bzlas spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang lha'i dmigs pa'am/ 'od zer spro bsdu'am tha na sngags kyi sgra lhang lhang ba de dang shes pa 'dres pa ci thub la 'bad pa gal che zhing / de ltar ma yin pa'i tha mal pa'i rnam rtog dang bsres pa'i ngang du yun ring po'i bar du byas kyang nus pa shin tu chung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan de bas na bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i tshe/ bying rmugs rnam g.yeng thams cad drag tu bzlog nas ma 'bad na nus pa 'dres 'phrog par bshad de/ nā ro ta pas/ gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pa spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /sngags la sogs pa gsang zhing shib bur bzla dgos te/ rtsa ltung bdun pa'i nyes pa 'ong ba'i phyir/ nā ro ta pas/ gsal zhing sngags sgra che ba spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i spyod pas tho rangs dang / snga dro dang / phyi dro dang / srod kyi thun dang bzhi'i rim pas 'jug cing / de yang dang po skyabs 'gro nas rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar la tha mal gyi long gtam dang mi bsre bar smra bcad kyi ngang nas bya dgos shing gzhan du na bsnyen pa'i don med de/ nā ro ta pas/ nus pa myur du skye 'dod na/ /smra ba bcad na dngos grub 'phel/ /lo gcig sil bur bzlas pa bas/ /zla gcig smra bcad bya ba gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar byed pa'i gnas kyang ri khrod dben par byas na legs par gsungs te/ nā ro ta pas/ yul dgon lo gcig byas pa bas/ /ri khrod zhag gcig bsnyen pa gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang thun skabs ma gtogs 'gro 'dug byed pa sogs mi nyan cing stan gcig gi steng du tshar dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ bsgrub sngags 'khyams shing bzla ba spang / /zhes so/

/bsnyen pa ma tshar bar la stan yang spo 'jug mi nyan te/ klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ mal stan nam mkha'i mthongs su sprugs/ /da res sgrub pa gang byas gya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gtso bo yab yum la 'bum phrag bzhi re/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re re bzla dgos shing / dmigs bsal can la de las mang ba yang bzla dgos par bshad do/ /de ltar bzlas pa'i tshe nad pa dang / rgan po yin na skabs su ngal bso ba'i bar g.yas g.yon du bag tsam re sngas pa la nyes pa med dam sems/ de ma gtogs pa gong sbyor ba'i skabs kyi lus gnad dang mi 'bral bar dgos te/ nā ro ta pas/ mi mos nyal sngags bzla ba spang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gong ma de rnams kyi don mdor bsdus nas brjod na/ bsnyen pa gang yin pa ma tshar gyi bar la/ thun la 'jug pa nas mthar bsngo ba'i bar la/ nyal ba dang / ldang ba dang / bzhad gad dang / rtsa chu 'chag pa dang / zas za ba dang / mal stan spo ba dang / sprugs pa dang / mi dang tshig bsre ba dang / sngags kyi sgra rgyun bcad pa dang / lha dang sngags 'khor gyi dmigs pa mi byed pa dang / 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mi byed pa dang / phreng ba mdo 'dzin la thug nas/ phyir mi ldog par mdo 'dzin 'gom nas 'gro ba rnams spang dgos te/ sngags rnams bzla ba'i man ngag ni/ nyal nas ma yin langs nas min/ /dgod cing ma yin 'chag cing min/ /za zhing ma yin stan mi sprugs/ /phyi yi rgyud ni skad mi bsre/ /nang gi rgyud ni sgra mi gcad/ /gsang ba'i rgyud ni ting nge 'dzin/ /'phro 'du gcad par mi bya'o/ /lag phreng mi 'gom mdo 'dzin rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de yang bsnyen sgrub dus su yin gyi/ gzhan du na/ nā ro ta pas/ phyag rgya chen po 'dod pa la/ /de nyid zhal 'khyams rtag tu 'don/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa rjes la/ thun bzhag ran pa dang / pha rgyud ma rgyud so so'i yi ge brgya pa bdun nam lnga la sogs pa bton nas lhag chad kha bskang zhing bsnyen pa bsdu bar bya ste/

bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis da lta'i dus 'di la bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa'i mtshan nas smos pa dang / de'i rtsa sngags snying po sogs gang bzlas pa de la grangs ma nor bar byas nas brgya stong sogs 'di tshar ba de sku gsung thugs la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes grangs yi dam la gtad pa gdams pa'i mchog yin te/ nā ro ta pas/ 'phral gyi nus pa 'dod pa la/ /smra bcad grangs dang bcas pa 'don/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas rten 'brel snying po'i rab gnas byas pas byin rlabs mi nyams shing nus pa che ru 'gro bar bshad pas/ ye dharmā bdun la sogs pa ci nus su bgrang ngo / /de rjes dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtor ma gtang ba'am/ thun bzhi ka la gtor ma 'phrod na rab/ de ma grub kyang srod thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma rgyas par gtang dgos shing / gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa rang rang gi sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa btab cing / kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i tshul gyis longs spyod do/ /lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ gtor ma gtong ba/ satstshwa gdab pa/ mdo 'don pa sogs dge bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas sbyin sreg phyogs gcig tu blug pa dang /

nyin bzhin bsnyen pa byed cing mtshan bzhin de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg blugs nas bsnyen pa dang tshar mnyam byed pa'i lugs gnyis bshad pas gang bde byas pas 'ong zhing / de'i lag len mthong ba brgyud pa bzhin legs par bya dgos te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas 'grub pa med/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byung / /gsang sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas/ /sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gi sgo nas grangs kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan byas na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu tshegs med par 'grub par gsungs te/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dman pa zhi sogs bzhi/ /'bring grub chen brgyad/ 'bring gi mchog mkha' spyod rig 'dzin/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyang bsnyen pa song nas sgrub pas 'grub par bshad/ mchog gi dngos grub kyang myur du 'grub par bshad de/ nā ro ta pas/ sgrub pa po yi rnal 'byor pas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di ldan na/ /tshe gcig mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po nas bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de bzhin yin zhing / bskul lugs kyang rtsa sngags kyis sku/ snying pos gsung / nye snying gis thugs bskul zhing 'bod par gsungs te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ dpe dang bcas pa gsungs pa ni/ dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na/ /mdun du nges pa 'ong ba bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs de de bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bas na sems kyi rnam g.yeng spangs nas rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas byas na/ rgyal ba rnams byon nas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa la the tshom med par shes par bya'o/ /rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po'i bsnyen pa byed na yang /

lha'i bskyed chog dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la sogs pa mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar byed pa dang / gzhan thun gyi go rim dang dmigs pa'i gcun thabs rnams la khyad par med pas de ltar shes par bya'o/ /bsnyen thabs dngos grub bum bzang 'di/ /kun dga' bzang po la sogs pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi/ /gsung dang grub thob rnams kyi gzhung / /rgyud sde mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur sogs rnam par dag pa yi/ /lung gis cung zad gsal byas nas/ /shākya'i dge slong rgyal khams pa/ /bsod nams seng ges bsdebs pa lags/ /rang bzo'i nyes pa med par sems/ /skal bzang thar pa don gnyer ba'i/ /ring na bzhugs pa'i buddha ratna bla ma bas/ /dgos zhes gsung 'phrin byung mod kyang / /khyab pa 'du byed dbang gyur pas/ /yun ring ma grub bzod par gsol/ /ma nor lam mchog bzang po la/ /dad pa ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /dka' ba brgyas rnyed dka' ba yi/ /dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /snying po len par ma byas na/ /phyi nas 'di 'dra 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /brtson pa chen pos 'bad 'tshal lo/ /'di bgyis pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba dri med gang thob des/ /bdag dang mar gyur sems can rnams/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog dang / /'bral med bla mas rjes bzung zhing / /bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin byed pa dang / /lam gyi bar chad kun bral nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang de/ /myur du thob par bya phyir bsngo/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun du gnas gyur cig/ //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE
